verdict.rationale: Teller documents a quickstart that ends with linking your first financial accounts, plus a simulated-data sandbox with documented test flows (e.g. OTP code `0000`). The only client library evidenced is a first-party React hook/component for Teller Connect. Auth uses Teller-issued mTLS client certificates, which adds setup friction beyond simple API keys, and self-serve issuance is only implied by the existence of a Teller Dashboard. Missing for 10: explicit self-serve signup and credential issuance, server-side SDKs in multiple languages, evidence the quickstart is runnable end-to-end, and independent hands-on corroboration of time-to-first-sandbox-link.
